questions.question: What percentage of Americans say they have at least one bucket list goal?
questions.answer: 95% - Almost all Americans surveyed have at least one bucket list goal.

questions.question: On average, how many items do people have on their bucket lists?
questions.answer: 19 - Survey respondents listed an average of 19 bucket list items.

questions.question: True or False: Visiting landmarks is more popular than traveling by plane or train on bucket lists.
questions.answer: True - Visiting landmarks in Europe, North America, and Asia ranks very high.

questions.question: Which of these experiences is commonly listed on bucket lists?
questions.answer: All of the above - Many bucket lists mix travel, personal challenges, and financial goals.

questions.question: True or False: Most people think their financial situation does not affect achieving bucket list items.
questions.answer: False - 86% said money or finances make it harder to complete their lists.

questions.question: If you could only pick one adventure, which would likely appear on the most bucket lists?
questions.answer: Traveling abroad - Visiting new countries and seeing famous landmarks is extremely popular.

questions.question: True or False: Most bucket list items are risky or dangerous activities.
questions.answer: False - While some adventures are extreme, many items are simple, like traveling or meeting celebrities.

questions.question: Which of these is a popular goal combining adventure and personal growth?
questions.answer: Learning to swing dance - Fun personal challenges often mix adventure with skill-building.

questions.question: True or False: Bucket lists usually stay the same throughout life.
questions.answer: False - People’s goals often change as they grow older and their priorities shift.

questions.question: Which of these best describes a good bucket list goal?
options: Something that scares you but excites you
questions.answer: Something that scares you but excites you - The best bucket list items push you out of your comfort zone while being meaningful.
